Bill.BriefDescription: Increasing penalties for falsifying hours of service for commercial motor vehicles.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to increasing penalties for falsifying hours ofservice for commercial motor vehicles; adding a new section to chapter46.32 RCW; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.32 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) It is a traffic infraction for a commercial motor vehicledriver to violate RCW 46.32.010 and 49 C.F.R. 395.3 by falsifying thelogbook of hours of service. For the purposes of this section,"commercial motor vehicle driver" means a person who operates acommercial motor vehicle. (2) A person who violates this section is subject to a penalty ofseven hundred twentyfive dollars. The penalties in this section shallnot be reduced or suspended and shall be distributed as follows: (a)Ninety percent to the motor vehicle account for increased commercialmotor vehicle enforcement; and (b) the remainder as provided in chapter3.62 RCW.
